answer: Use a clean one-page layout with clear sections: Contact, Summary, Education, Skills, Projects, Experience. Match keywords from the job description. Quantify impact (users, latency, revenue). Use action verbs: Built, Designed, Optimized.
Placement prep: (1) DSA daily — arrays, trees, graphs. (2) CS core — DBMS, OS, networks. (3) 2–3 STAR project stories. (4) Mock interviews weekly. (5) Apply early with tailored resumes.
Master Python basics: data types, functions, OOP, file I/O. Practice on LeetCode easy/medium. Build a small Flask API. Read the official docs and PEP 8 style.
Flask: use application factory, blueprints, and config classes. Add Flask-Login for auth, validate inputs, and return JSON for APIs. Deploy with Gunicorn + Docker on Render or AWS.
Learn ES6+, async/await, fetch API, and DOM manipulation. Build a todo or weather app. Then move to React for component-based UIs.
React: components, props, state, useEffect, and React Router. Build a dashboard or portfolio site. Connect to a REST API you built with Flask.
DSA roadmap: arrays → strings → linked lists → stacks/queues → trees → graphs → DP. Solve 2 problems daily. Track patterns (two pointers, sliding window, BFS/DFS).
DBMS: normalization, keys, joins, indexing, transactions (ACID). Practice SQL on HackerRank. Understand when to use SQL vs MongoDB.
SQL essentials: SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, subqueries, window functions. Index columns used in WHERE/JOIN. Explain query plans for interviews.
OS topics: processes vs threads, scheduling, memory (paging, virtual memory), deadlocks, synchronization. Revise with OS quizzes on Vidyastra.
Technical interviews: clarify requirements, discuss brute force then optimize, write clean code, test edge cases. Behavioral: use STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
For internships: polish GitHub (README, demos), tailor resume per role, apply on LinkedIn/Wellfound/company portals, and follow up politely after 1 week.
Improve GitHub: pin 3 best repos, add README with setup/screenshots, use meaningful commits, add LICENSE, and contribute to good-first-issue projects.
LinkedIn: professional photo, headline with role + stack, summary with projects, list skills, request recommendations from mentors/peers, post weekly learnings.
HTML/CSS: semantic tags, flexbox/grid, mobile-first CSS, accessibility basics. Build a responsive landing page before frameworks.
Pick a target role (SDE, Full Stack, Data Scientist). Map required skills, fill gaps with courses + projects, take weekly quizzes, and track progress on your dashboard.
ML path: Python → NumPy/Pandas → scikit-learn → one deep learning framework. Complete a Kaggle competition and document your pipeline in a notebook.
For NLP projects: learn tokenization, embeddings, and HuggingFace Transformers. Fine-tune a small model and deploy with a simple API.
System design: requirements, API design, database choice, caching, load balancing, message queues. Study real architectures (URL shortener, chat, feed).
Study effectively: set 2-hour blocks, one topic per block, active recall via quizzes, and review mistakes within 48 hours. Use the Study Planner for a 7-day schedule.
